description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of time related to “Reduction” and “Efficient deployment”. The chart contains two slices, one blue and one orange. The blue slice is labeled “Efficient deployment” and displays “26.2s (30.08%)” within the slice, while the orange slice is labeled “Reduction” and displays “60.9s (69.92%)” within the slice. The “Efficient deployment” slice is visually offset from the larger “Reduction” slice. Percentage labels are included directly within each slice, and a legend is not present. The slices appear ordered from largest to smallest based on their visual proportion.
